Observed at +0.8975915908813477s — page 1
Usage: mcpjam cloud eval gate [options] [command]
Apply a pass/fail policy to a finished eval run and set an exit code (0 pass or
waived, 1 eval failure, 2 usage, 3 incomplete)
Options:
--run <id> Eval run ID (from `eval run`)
--project <id-or-name> Project name or ID (defaults to the most recently updated project)
--min-pass-rate-percent <0-100> Minimum share of iterations that must pass, as a percentage
--no-gating-score-errors Fail if any required scorer errored during the run
--min-scorer-pass-rate <scorerId=percent> Minimum pass rate for one scorer (repeatable) (default: [])
--min-mean-score <scorerId=0..1> Minimum mean score for one scorer (repeatable) (default: [])
--baseline <runId> Baseline run ID to gate a regression delta against; mutually exclusive with --baselin
e-sha
--baseline-sha <sha> Baseline source commit SHA, resolved to the completed run in this suite recorded agai
nst it; mutually exclusive with --baseline
--min-sample-size <n> Iterations required on EACH side before a pass-rate regression is decidable (default
5); requires --baseline or --baseline-sha
--min-effect-size-percent <0-100> Smallest pass-rate drop worth failing on, as a percentage (default 1); requires --bas
eline or --baseline-sha
--gate-deterministic-regressions Fail if a deterministic required scorer flipped from passed to failed; requires --bas
eline or --baseline-sha
--max-p95-latency-increase-ms <ms> Fail if p95 end-to-end latency rose by more than this many milliseconds vs the baseli
ne; requires --baseline or --baseline-sha
--max-cost-usd <usd> Fail if the run's MCPJam-billed cost exceeded this many dollars; non-gateable when th
e run's cost is unknown or only partly measured
--max-cost-increase-percent <percent> Fail if cost rose by more than this percentage of the baseline's; requires --baseline
or --baseline-sha
--wait Poll until the run reaches a terminal status
--wait-timeout <ms> Give up waiting after this many milliseconds (default 600000; a run held for its judg
e gets up to 31 more minutes unless this flag is set)
--reporter <json-summary|junit-xml|html> Write a structured report to stdout instead of the default output
--out <path> Atomically write the structured report selected by --reporter (default: json-summary)
--no-suite-policy Skip the stored suite quality-gate; evaluate only the flag/base report
-h, --help display help for command
Commands:
waive [options] Override a FAILING run's gate until an expiry you name. Does not make the run pass: t
he run keeps its result, and the waiver is named in every report and check.
unwaive [options] Revoke a gate waiver, putting the gate and the GitHub Check Run back. Idempotent.
